headline.zh-CN: 最终母带访问与终审保护
headline.en: Final master access and final-review safeguards

summary.zh-CN: 专辑成员可在已完成曲目详情试听、下载最终母带；制作中母带和历史草稿保持参与者权限，终审批复严格绑定当前制作周期。
summary.en: Album members can play and download the final master from completed track details. In-progress masters and historical drafts remain participant-only, and final approval is restricted to the current workflow cycle.

description.zh-CN: 已完成曲目的最终母带可在详情页试听和下载。母带工作台、制作中交付与历史草稿继续向制作参与者开放；重新开启制作后，普通成员的母带访问随状态收回。
description.en: Members can play and download the final master on completed track details. The mastering workspace, in-progress deliveries and historical drafts stay restricted to production participants. Reopening a track withdraws ordinary members' master access.

description.zh-CN: 母带试听和下载接口按曲目状态与交付版本校验权限。本地音频通过受保护接口提供，R2 音频使用短期签名下载地址。
description.en: Master playback and download endpoints check track state and delivery identity. Local audio is served through protected endpoints, and R2 audio uses short-lived signed download URLs.

description.zh-CN: 终审批复要求当前制作周期的母带交付，防止重新开启后批准旧周期母带并提前完成曲目。新上传文件使用独立存储名称，保留历史音频内容。
description.en: Final approval requires a master delivery from the current workflow cycle, preventing reopened tracks from completing through an older delivery. Newly uploaded files use unique storage names to preserve historical audio.
